title: Local Combinatorial Criteria for Geometric Hyper-ideal Triangulations via Combinatorial Ricci Flow
summary: We give local combinatorial criteria for realizing prescribed ideal triangulations by nondegenerate hyperbolic truncated tetrahedra. A local bichromatic criterion allows valence-7 edges when tetrahedra meeting low-valence edges use at most two quotient-edge classes. Using the extended combinatorial Ricci flow, we obtain parameter-dependent criteria for triangulations of minimum valence 6. Symmetric and pair-min angle estimates yield explicit valence conditions, including mixed conditions on entire edge stars. The proofs use analytic angle inequalities and rigorous interval evaluations.…
